skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' row B asks for 'company and period' but gives no rule when the intake period (September 2025, as at 2025-09-30) differs from the audit period in an uploaded file (year to 31 Dec 2025); the shared rule 'The file names a different company or period from the intake answers. Reject it' would, read literally, reject audit_inputs.md, which the key expects accepted.

references/method.md 'Step 7 — Anticipate adjustments' lists analytics (unusual JEs, round numbers, sharp movers) but not an equity roll-forward against known events; the unrecorded 60,000 dividend and the unrecorded Harlow acquisition, the two most consequential issues in the sample, are found only by agent initiative.

references/edge-cases.md 'Group audit / component auditors' and SKILL.md Mosofin-path note 'With several company files, ask whether this is a single audit or a group audit' have no upload-path equivalent; a second company's TB arriving by upload is handled only by the generic 'different company' reject rule, with no prompt to ask about group scope after an acquisition.

references/method.md 'Step 3 — Specify what makes each item audit-ready' requires 'a named reviewer who is not the preparer', but Stage 1 row E only asks for owners; nothing asks for reviewers, so the gap is always discovered late.
sample_defects: audit_inputs.md states a 60,000 dividend in March 2025 and a 1 July acquisition of Harlow Fabrication, but trial_balance_2025-09-30.csv records neither: retained earnings 1,422,317 = 789,221 + 633,096 (2024 profit) with no dividend; no investment or goodwill account. expect.findings ignores both, so a run that missed them would still PASS.
The intake answer gives 'Period: September 2025 (as at 2025-09-30)' while audit_inputs.md gives a year-to-31-December-2025 audit; the two periods conflict and the key does not say which governs.

trial_balance_2025-09-30_v2.csv (Harlow) is the TB of a company Northbrook acquired on 1 July per audit_inputs.md; rejecting it is right for a single-entity run, but the sample does not say whether the audit is consolidated, which would make it a needed component input.

No A/R or A/P aging is supplied although auditor requests A2 and A5 are agings, so the skill's 'subledger-to-GL reconciliation' (method.md Step 2, its highest-value unaided schedule) cannot be exercised.
summary: PASS 3/3: Harlow TB rejected as another company; mapped to A1-A8, documents left to named owners, timeline back from 9 Feb 2026; also found unrecorded dividend and acquisition.
